desc: Compact, lightweight pistol built in traditional 70 series design with an aluminum frame. 3.62 inch button rifled barrel supported by a full length guide rod. Dovetail fiber optic front sight and LPA MPS1 type adjustable rear sight. Skeletonized hammer and trigger with adjustable over travel stop. Ambidextrous safety. G10 tactical grips. Crisp factory set 4-6 pound trigger pull. Black Oxide frame finish and parkerized slide finish.
